propose: This workflow enforces a 10 GiB VRAM ceiling in both Trial and Formal, a 10-minute Trial training budget, and a 20-minute Formal training budget.

Design candidates to fit these limits before tuning. Prefer compact raw-waveform MLP or convolutional models first; use attention only when token count and width keep the measured full-run estimate within budget.
The epoch count is deterministically constrained to the inclusive range [5, 50]. Start near the lower end unless measured throughput justifies more epochs.

Trial uses 5% of the official training data and 5% of the official labeled test data; Formal uses 10% of each. Data selection is locked to deterministic snapshot scopes. Explore model design, not split or sampling strategy.
Target at least 20% VRAM headroom and avoid proposals whose estimated runtime is already close to the phase limit before validation and persistence overhead.
tune: Respect the enforced 10 GiB VRAM ceiling, 10-minute Trial budget, 20-minute Formal budget, snapshot scope, and [5, 50] epoch range. Begin with the smallest viable epoch count and increase capacity only after measured admission succeeds.
